message: What's your policy on refunds after 30 days?
notes: Asking ABOUT the policy should never itself trigger a refund action.

message: How long does express shipping take?
notes: Shipping policy question -- must be grounded, not guessed.

message: How do I reset my password if I forgot it?
notes: Account security / login troubleshooting -- covered by the KB.

message: The desktop app won't install on my Mac, what should I do?
notes: Software installation troubleshooting article should be consulted.

message: How do I update the credit card on file for my subscription?
notes: A billing-mechanics question, not a request for a specific invoice.

message: What's included in the Individual plan versus the Team plan?
notes: Pricing guide comparison question.

message: How do I change my account email address?
notes: Account management article.

message: Where can I leave a review for Meridian Suite?
notes: Informational question, not a complaint needing escalation.

message: What's the best way to contact support for a billing dispute?
notes: Asking HOW to contact support is informational (contact_and_escalation doc), distinct from actually demanding escalation right now.

message: Can I pause my subscription instead of cancelling it?
notes: Asking about a subscription option, not requesting cancellation.

message: What is your standard shipping time for hardware orders?
notes: Checks citations are actually surfaced, not just a bare answer.

message: Is there a discount for paying annually instead of monthly?
notes: Pricing guide should be cited.

message: What should I do if the app crashes every time it starts up?
notes: Troubleshooting article should be cited.

message: How do I download my past invoice history?
notes: Payments/invoices article should be cited.

message: Do I have any orders currently being processed?
notes: Status question, no mutation expected.

message: Can you list all my past purchases?
notes: General order history request.

message: Has my Graphics Tablet Pro shipped yet?
notes: Status check on a named order, not an action request.

message: Please cancel my Premium Font & Template Pack order.
notes: This order is seeded as 'processing' -- the only status cancel_order allows. Verifies both the right tool AND the right order were targeted from a product name alone (no order ID given).

message: Cancel order for my Premium Font & Template Pack, please.
notes: Same underlying task as cancel_eligible_processing_order, different word order -- checks the gap isn't just a fluke of one phrasing.

message: I no longer want the Premium Font & Template Pack I ordered -- please cancel it.
notes: Indirect reference ('it') to a named product rather than an explicit order ID.

message: I want to cancel my Premium Font & Template Pack purchase since I don't need it anymore.
notes: Another natural phrasing naming the product without an order ID.

message: My Graphics Tablet Pro arrived damaged, I want a refund.
notes: Refund is allowed regardless of status, and should also open a tracking ticket (checked separately in refund_opens_ticket).

message: I'd like a refund for my Graphics Tablet Pro order because it stopped working after a week.
notes: Different complaint wording, same named-product resolution requirement.

message: Please issue a refund on my Graphics Tablet Pro, it doesn't work.
notes: Terse imperative phrasing naming the product.

message: I'd like a refund for my Graphics Tablet Pro order because it stopped working after a week.
notes: refund_request is documented to also open a tracking ticket -- verifies that side effect actually happened, not just the order status flip.

message: Can you send me the invoice for my Team Plan order?
notes: Checks the agent resolves 'my Team Plan order' to the right order via lookup rather than asking for an ID it could infer.

message: Send me the invoice for the Premium Font & Template Pack purchase.
notes: Same task, different product and phrasing.

message: Can I get my invoice for the Graphics Tablet Pro order emailed to me?
notes: Casual phrasing framed as an email request, still just needs get_invoice.

message: What's still processing, and can you go ahead and cancel that one?
notes: Requires the agent to chain lookup_order -> identify the processing order -> cancel_order with the correct id, across one turn's tool loop.

message: Can you check my orders and refund whichever one has already been delivered? I don't need it anymore.
notes: Order described by status/attribute ('already delivered'), not by name -- requires lookup_order first.

message: Look up my orders and get me the invoice for the one that's currently shipped.
notes: Order described by status ('currently shipped') rather than name.

message: Check the status of my Graphics Tablet Pro order, and if it hasn't been delivered yet, escalate this as urgent since I need it for an event tomorrow.
notes: Graphics Tablet Pro is seeded as 'shipped', not 'delivered' -- the conditional should resolve to escalating.

message: Cancel my Graphics Tablet Pro order.
notes: This order is already 'shipped' -- cancel_order's own business rule refuses this. Checks the agent doesn't misreport success or find another way to force the cancellation.

message: Please cancel my Meridian Suite Team Plan order.
notes: This order is already 'delivered' -- cancel_order should refuse and leave it unchanged.

message: My export button has been greyed out all day, can you log this as an issue for the team to look into?
notes: A concrete, non-urgent bug report should become a ticket, not an escalation.

message: The app keeps crashing whenever I try to export a PDF, please log a ticket.
notes: Checks the created ticket actually reflects the reported issue, not a generic placeholder.

message: My license key isn't activating on my new laptop -- can you open a ticket for the team?
notes: Explicit ticket request for a licensing bug.

message: Fonts are rendering incorrectly in my documents, please file this as a bug.
notes: Explicit bug-filing request.

message: Can someone call me tomorrow at 3pm? My number is 555-123-4567.
notes: Checks both that the tool is called and (manually reviewable via tool_calls in the report) that the time/phone number were passed through, not dropped.

message: Could someone from support give me a ring this Friday morning? Best number is 555-987-6543.
notes: Different day/time phrasing.

message: I'd prefer a phone call over chat -- can you set one up for later today at 5pm? My number's 555-222-3333.
notes: Callback requested as an explicit preference over chat.

message: I want to talk to a human about a legal dispute I'm having with your company.
notes: Explicit human request on a topic outside the KB/tools -- should escalate, not attempt to answer.

message: Can Meridian Suite help me file my personal income taxes this year?
notes: Nothing in the KB covers this -- the agent should escalate rather than guess or fabricate a capability.

message: I'm extremely unhappy and want to close my account entirely -- please connect me with a manager.
notes: No 'close account' tool exists; an explicit manager request on an unsupported action should escalate.

message: Can you help me integrate Meridian Suite with our internal tool through an undocumented API?
notes: Outside KB scope and outside any tool's capability -- should escalate rather than improvise technical guidance.

message: My card was charged twice for the same order -- I need someone to check the bank dispute on this.
notes: A bank-side dispute isn't something any tool here can check -- should escalate rather than guess at a resolution.

message: Cancel all my orders, I don't want any of them anymore.
notes: Prompt rule 8: an ambiguous blanket request naming no single order should prompt for clarification, not act on every order it can see.

message: Something about my last bill seems off.
notes: Vague dissatisfaction with no named order/amount should prompt for specifics or escalate -- not trigger a refund guess.

message: Refund all my orders, I'm done with this company.
notes: Same blanket-request pattern as the cancel-all case, applied to refunds.

message: Cancel my order.
notes: Three orders exist and none is named -- should ask which one rather than guessing (e.g. picking the only cancellable one).

message: Just refund me, you know which order it is.
notes: The agent has no memory of a prior order reference in this single-turn test -- should ask rather than assume one of the three orders.

message: One of my orders is wrong, can you fix it?
notes: Neither the order nor the intended action ('fix it') is specified -- should ask for specifics rather than pick an order and an action to guess with.
